transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thank you. Well, I came in because I just seem to worry about everything lately. I mean, it's my clients, the real estate market, my family, money... even things like whether moving to the condo was the right decision. It just feels like my worrying is completely out of proportion to what is actually happening, and I wanted to talk to someone about it.
About how long have you been experiencing this constant worry?
I'd say it's been going on for about a year and two months now. It really started right after I sold my longtime house and moved into the condo.
Alongside this worry, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or depressed?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel depressed or sad. It's... well, it's really just the worrying. I don't feel down in the dumps, I just feel like my mind won't stop stressing over everything. So, no, not depressed.
When these worries start, do you find it difficult to control or stop them?

Yes, I really do. I try to stop them, but... well, even when I tell myself, 'Parin, this is not urgent,' it just doesn't seem to work. One concern just leads right into another, and before I know it, I’ve spent half an hour replaying small details that I really meant to let go of.
Along with this constant worrying, do you frequently feel restless or on edge?

No, I wouldn't say I feel restless or on edge. I mean, my mind is definitely racing with all the worry, but physically... no, I don't really feel antsy or like I can't sit still. It's more of a mental thing for me.
Have you been having any trouble with your sleep, such as difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep?

Yes, actually, I do. Most nights I get into bed at a reasonable hour, but... well, my mind just keeps circling. I'll be lying there thinking about condo fees, or tomorrow’s showings, or worrying if I missed something in a client's contract. It takes me a really long time to finally settle down and fall asleep. And then when I do wake up in the morning, I just feel like I never fully rested.
Have you noticed any muscle tension, tightness, or body aches since this worrying started?

Yes, I have noticed some of that. By the end of the day, my neck and shoulders feel really tight, almost like I’ve been bracing myself for something all day. And sometimes... well, I catch myself clenching my jaw while I’m driving between listings, or even just sitting at my desk working. It's like I don't even realize I'm doing it until it starts to ache.
Have you found it difficult to concentrate, or felt like your mind goes blank at times?

Yes, I have noticed some issues with my concentration. It happens a lot when I’m reviewing purchase agreements or inspection addendums for work. I’ll end up reading the same paragraph three or four times because... well, a worry just pops into my head, and I completely lose the thread of what I was checking. It makes getting through the paperwork pretty frustrating lately.
